SSRIs such as fluoxetine have produced beneficial effects as an adjunct to central stimulants in small numbers of patients with comorbid disorders such as de- pression or obsessive-compulsive disorder;1-3 although there is insufficient evidence to assess their efficacy in ADHD alone. 1.
